points.description: States that the region of rejection is the range/set of values (of the test statistic, or area of the sampling distribution/critical region) for which the null hypothesis is rejected.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only vaguely right, e.g. mentions a critical region/range of values or the area beyond the critical value but does not link it to rejecting the null hypothesis.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for the core idea: the values or area where the null hypothesis gets rejected, in any wording (e.g. "critical region", "if the test value falls here, reject H0"). Give 1 mark for a half-right answer, such as naming a range or critical region without saying it leads to rejection of the null. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers, such as the region where H0 is accepted.
